explanation: Dense cluster with G=5 and two 20-mass bodies only 1.0 apart produces very large mutual accelerations. With max dt=1/30 the integrator uses only 6 substeps per outer step, insufficient to resolve the rapid infall; particles gain ~8-10 speed in 2 steps and close pairs shrink to ~0.55, so leapfrog energy error accumulates beyond the 2% tolerance by step 2.
